description: herdr-conductor: deny the herdr never-list in Bash; one context line at session start when herdr matters here

hooks.command: command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 -I "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/scripts/session_context.py" || { command -v herdr >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"herdr-conductor: python3 not found, so the guard hook is inactive and herdr-snapshot will not run."}}'; true; }
